basis.by: Inland Revenue (Te Tari Taake), New Zealand
basis.label: Plumbing fixtures
basis.note: Printed page 44. Plumbing fixtures: toilets, urinals, basins, drinking fountains. Note the separate row 'Sanitary appliances' (8 years), which under NZ Building Code usage means appliances such as dish and clothes washers, not fixtures; it is not mapped. BDFO Building fit-out (when in books separately from building cost). Printed DV 8%, SL 6%. Tax depreciation lives set by the Commissioner of Inland Revenue for New Zealand income tax, not engineering or asset-management lives; they are banded and often short (e.g. reticulation piping 25 years). The July 2021 edition was the newest PDF reachable; the online Depreciation Rate Finder may hold later determinations.
